physics-killer-10.title: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-10.topic: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-10.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-10.material: Tijaabada saamaynta photoelectric-ka, iftiin hal-midab ah ayaa lagu iftiimiyay saxan bir ah tamarta kinetic-ka ugu badan ee photoelectrons-ka waxaana lagu cabbiray laba soo noqnoqosho: $7.5\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.0\\,\\mathrm{eV}$; $9.0\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.6\\,\\mathrm{eV}$. Isticmaal joogtada Planck $h=4.0\\times10^{-15}\\,\\mathrm{eV\\cdot s}$ (qiime qiyaas ah oo dhibaatadan ah). Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, soo noqnoqoshada xadka $\\nu_0$ ee biraha iyo danabka istaagga $12.0\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$ marka iftiin soo noqnoqosho $V_0$ la isticmaalo?
physics-killer-10.thinking.0: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-10.s.s1.prompt: Tijaabada saamaynta photoelectric-ka, iftiin hal-midab ah ayaa lagu iftiimiyay saxan bir ah tamarta kinetic-ka ugu badan ee photoelectrons-ka waxaana lagu cabbiray laba soo noqnoqosho: $7.5\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.0\\,\\mathrm{eV}$; $9.0\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.6\\,\\mathrm{eV}$. Isticmaal joogtada Planck $h=4.0\\times10^{-15}\\,\\mathrm{eV\\cdot s}$ (qiime qiyaas ah oo dhibaatadan ah). Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, soo noqnoqoshada xadka $\\nu_0$ ee biraha iyo danabka istaagga $12.0\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$ marka iftiin soo noqnoqosho $V_0$ la isticmaalo?
physics-killer-10.s.s1.explain: Laga bilaabo xogta (7.5, 1.0): $W=h\\nu-E_k=3.0-1.0=2.0\\,\\mathrm{eV}$ (hubi xogta labaad: $4.0\\times10^{-15}\\times9.0\\times10^{14}-1.6=3.6-1.6=2.0$). Soo noqnoqoshada xadka $\\nu_0=\\dfrac{W}{h}=\\dfrac{2.0}{4.0\\times10^{-15}}=5.0\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$. Marka $\\nu=12.0\\times10^{14}\\,\\mathrm{Hz}$, $h\\nu=4.8\\,\\mathrm{eV}$ iyo $E_k=4.8-2.0=2.8\\,\\mathrm{eV}$, sidaas darteed $V_0=2.8\\,\\mathrm{V}$. Khalad ahaanshaha shaqada-dhaqdhaqaaqa inuu yahay $W=1.0\\,\\mathrm{eV}$ wuxuu bixiyaa $\\nu_0=2.5\\times10^{14}$ iyo $V_0=3.8\\,\\mathrm{V}$ (doodda 1); ilaawidda ka jarista shaqada-dhaqdhaqaaqa waxay bixisaa $4.8\\,\\mathrm{V}$ (doodda 2); isticmaalka $h\\nu=3.0\\,\\mathrm{eV}$ sida shaqada-dhaqdhaqaaqa waxay bixisaa $\\nu_0=7.5\\times10^{14}$ iyo $V_0=1.8\\,\\mathrm{V}$ (doodda 3).
